label: Causal possession bottleneck: mode of possession, the more-such package and the formal gap
summary: Warrant-phase checkpoint on the top substantive bottleneck family (computed ranking in docs/notes/spine-dependency-map.md, 2026-11-27). The unrestricted maxim 376d6a5a ranks first because the distinct-cause version 2c0b9bd7 is derived only through the strength application 777d3b8d or the cycle with 'more such' d5a94eb1; no route consumer uses its self-causation case. Verified: for every single act predicate shared by the possession premise and the exceeding step, the more-such package with the more-such bearer c11369aa read formally implies formal distinct-cause possession (moreSuchPackageForcesFormalPossession, premise-free). Verified finite controls shaped like induction heating, with the respect fixed: with the ordinary comparative (MORE_3) the exceeding step at inclusive act, 'more such' and formal possession at the threshold or degree-indexed respect fail; with an eminent comparative (MORE_4) the package holds at inclusive act; at the respect of having some heat formal possession holds and only MORE_3 'more such' fails; the formal reading of 'nothing moves except as in act' fails. MORE_3 and MORE_4 are registered as senses of the MORE disambiguation, and the ordinary-comparative gap e7db0c0f is a typed attack on d5a94eb1 on its MORE_3 reading, warranted by induction heating (stated as standard engineering practice). Rumford's boring trials count at most against the remote drive. Consumer audit: every God-existence and stage-two consumer applies d5a94eb1 only at esse (maximum as cause, maximum as effect, or any cause at esse); the arbitrary-r package is load-bearing only for preexistence 6b609ddc, the Cartesian containment results and legacy derivations that have siblings. No premise is established, defeated in the frontier sense, or closed.
blocker: For the God routes the load is the esse comparative: certify esse siblings (cffad050, or PrimaryCauseIsMoreSuchReading at esse for maximum-as-cause uses) for the consumers that still take d5a94eb1, and assess the claim that a maximum in being has no distinct cause of its being together with the degree-calibration family at esse (a961a13e, f6677834, 9eaa3b6e). At arbitrary r, MORE_4 has no specification.

current_assessment.scope: The causal possession family under DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION's CAUSE_2, the DISAMB-IN-ACT senses, the MORE senses of disambiguation cdb0de59 (MORE_1 primitive, MORE_3 ordinary, MORE_4 eminent) and DISAMB-ORDER-OF-BEING at esse; respects fixed as stated in the note (having some heat, a degree-indexed heat respect, or the threshold quality being hot).
current_assessment.assessment: Formal possession 26632e48 is contradicted by induction heating at a degree-indexed respect or the threshold quality 'being hot' (not at 'having some heat'), under the recorded meaning of CAUSE_2; it is not a candidate reading for the routes, and the formal reading of f296a694 fails in the same case, so the prima via needs the uniform inclusive reading. Inclusive possession 2c0b9bd7 is strong prima facie but light: on the power determination of IN_ACT_2, with power including an instrument's transient power and 'in a higher way' read without comparative content, it is near-analytic with no substantive objection identified; restricted to a principal agent's own power the instrument objection stays kept conditionally. 'More such' d5a94eb1 on MORE_3 and the inclusive exceeding step 7030af77 with MORE_3 are contradicted by the same case (typed attack from e7db0c0f); no record specifies MORE_4 at arbitrary r under which d5a94eb1 holds for every distinct cause, and the one recorded analogical order certifies it only with the primary as cause (29133b2b). The consumer audit changes the weight for the God routes: their consumers apply d5a94eb1 only at esse, so their load is the esse comparative (cffad050, its exceeding step at esse and the calibration premises it is derived from), not the arbitrary-r comparative; maximum-as-cause uses are certified on the attribution order with the primary as cause, maximum-as-effect uses need the open claim that a maximum has no distinct cause of its being. The arbitrary-r package stays load-bearing only for preexistence 6b609ddc and the Cartesian containment results. The mixed reading is excluded by moreSuchPackageForcesFormalPossession with the formal gap. 376d6a5a is unchanged. First grades; no earlier judgment is revised.
current_assessment.next_test: Certify esse siblings for the consumers still taking d5a94eb1 (ef122ccf, 8bbe817d, 87dd8489, 3eafe507, 815d22c8, godIsSimple and its dependants), then assess the maximum-has-no-distinct-esse-cause claim with the degree-calibration family at esse.
current_assessment.supersedes: The first-draft assessment of this attempt at bd881f72 (kept in assessment_history), whose item 3 placed the God routes' weight on the arbitrary-r comparative package; the modal-spine 2026-11-18 rows for 376d6a5a and rows 12 to 15 are kept.
current_assessment.evidence: Independent semantic challenge of PR-2166 at head 30ca1de01f2a47b8545d4e28fb8df126c70abc4a accepted the judgment with qualifications (3 P1: respect of r, Rumford overclaim, eminent comparative partly on record; 7 P2), accepting both Lean results, the cycle claim, the no-price rival and the separation of judgment from closure. Every finding is repaired on a later head of the same branch (note section 9); the repaired assertions and the consumer audit await the challenger's re-check.
